defs.def: occasionally rather than all of the time 有时；间或

ex.s: Sometimes, a cleaner living room is the best reward.
ex.t: 有时候，一个整洁的客厅就是最好的奖励。

ex.s: Sometimes she arrives early to serve the students early.
ex.t: 哪项最能描述作者的第一次团体面试？

ex.t: 格雷西教授耐心地要求我不要局限于喜欢或不喜欢，而是深入思考。

ex.s: Sometimes she prepares traditional Brazilian dishes ___48___ her native home; other times she ___49___ dinner courses with her favorite beers.
ex.t: 他想到，如果有合适的动植物组合，也许他能像大自然那样清理垃圾。

ex.s: “But it’s also a great ___53___, for it can sometimes take days to ___54___ a single event,” Ribeiro said.

ex.t: 14 这位女士今天早上听了谁的演讲？

ex.s: “Sometimes it surprises me that it works so well,” he says.
ex.t: 他说：“有时连我自己都惊讶于它效果这么好。”

ex.s: However, though it’s nice to get a few cents off a pack of sausages, it would help even more if they could sometimes   61   (offer) in smaller packs.

ex.s: Sometimes she would look in and ask what we were reading — not to check but to know.
ex.t: 太阳能技术的最新进展。

ex.s: Research sometimes proves, with data, what we more or less already know（e. g.
ex.t: 胡同代表了北京城的一个重要文化元素。

ex.s: Still, sometimes our assumptions are incorrect, and scientific findings surprise researchers, along with the rest of us.
ex.t: 与故宫、颐和园和天坛所代表的宫廷生活和上层文化相比，胡同反映了_____北京普通百姓的文化。

ex.s: Commonsense assumptions can sometimes prove wrong.
ex.t: 他们承诺会修理窗户。

ex.s: Good habits save time, energy and sometimes your life.
ex.t: 好习惯节省时间、精力，有时还能救命。

ex.s: Although landscapes in the Midwest tend to be quite similar, either farm fields or highways, sometimes I find distinctive character in the hills or lakes.
ex.t: 尽管中西部的风景往往大同小异，不是农田就是公路，但有时我会在丘陵或湖泊中发现独特的韵味。

ex.s: A good one can sometimes find you discounted tickets. ____37____ Then you won’t have to walk through several cars on a moving train three times a day for your meals.
ex.t: 一个好的旅行社有时能找到打折票。____37____这样你就不用一天三次穿过好几节车厢去吃饭了。

ex.s: Rather than setting plans in stone, I’ve learned that sometimes I need to take the opportunities that are offered, even if they don’t sound perfect at the time, and make the most of them.
ex.t: 与其把计划定死，我学到了有时候我需要抓住提供的机会，即使当时听起来并不完美，并且充分利用它们。

ex.s: The two travelers carefully   47   their trips, scheduling their days around the pets that are sometimes difficult to   48  .
ex.t: 这两位旅行者仔细   47  他们的行程，围绕有时很难   48  的宠物来安排日程。

ex.s: Sometimes our purpose is to achieve something;other times it may be to entertain inform, or persuade. ____12____ And when writing doesn’t seem to have any purpose or get any kind of meaningful response, then it can be hard to get excited about doing it.
ex.t: 有时我们的目的是为了达成某件事；其他时候可能是为了娱乐、告知或说服。____12____而当写作似乎没有任何目的或得不到任何有意义的回应时，就很难对此感到兴奋。

ex.s: Sometimes I think no matter where we come from, what colour our eyes, hair and skin, we are here to show our understanding and help.
ex.t: 有时我想，无论我们来自哪里，无论眼睛、头发和皮肤是什么颜色，我们来到这里都是为了表达理解并提供帮助。

ex.s: Science is a process of learning and discovery, and sometimes we learn that what we thought was right is wrong.
ex.t: 科学是一个学习和发现的过程，有时我们会发现原本以为正确的东西其实是错的。

ex.s: The couple are now at work on the toys seven days a week, sometimes for 10 hours a day.
ex.t: 这对夫妇现在每周七天都在制作玩具，有时一天工作10个小时。

ex.s: Sometimes it's hard to make a change, but I'm so glad I set the wheels of change in motion with that very small first step because it has led me to where I am today.
ex.t: 有时做出改变很难但我很高兴我用那小小的第一步启动了变化的轮因为它把我带到了今天的位置。

ex.s: Sometimes. students would ask me to describe all the things I had in it.
ex.t: 然后我就努力回忆那些我 supposedly 收走的不同物品——因为我很少真正留下它们。

ex.s: Sometimes devices fail because a good design is constructed with low quality materials incompetently applied.
ex.t: 或者也许一个设计效果太好，以至于在其他地方被反复采用，加上看似无害的改进，直到突然间完全失效。

ex.s: There’s a welcome familiarity — but also sometimes a slight suspicion that time has changed you both, and thus the relationship.
ex.t: 但书不会变，人会变。

ex.s: I was always an enthusiastic reader, sometimes reading up to three books a day as a child.
ex.t: 我一直是一个热情的读者，小时候有时一天读三本书。

ex.s: And there are questions about the films made outside the States, which sometimes are not monitored as closely as productions filmed in the Sates.
ex.t: 还有关于在美国以外拍摄的电影的问题，有时这些电影的监控不如在美国国内拍摄的那样严格。

ex.s: Sometimes, because a housewarming party happens shortly after a person moves into their new home, people may be asked to help unpack boxes.
ex.t: 乔迁派对得名于很久以前人们真的会带木柴到新家作为礼物这一事实。

ex.s: Sometimes it’s hard to let go.
ex.t: 从哪一天起私家车可以离开武汉？

ex.s: Humor lets you better understand life and sometimes helps you laugh at even the worst of your problems.
ex.t: 幽默让你更好地理解生活，有时甚至能让你对最糟糕的问题一笑置之。

ex.s: Some people--and I was one of them--believe that humorous complaints about the little problems of life make humor, and sometimes that is the case.
ex.t: 有些人——我也是其中之一——认为对生活中小问题的幽默抱怨就是幽默，有时确实如此。

ex.s: But sometimes，that is easier said than done.
ex.t: 这就是其中一次。

ex.s: Sometimes loud noises like these will scare bears off.
ex.t: 我用无线电呼叫营地管理员求助。

ex.s: I began to __32__ that we have many of the same values and sometimes the same opinions.
ex.t: 我开始 __32__ 意识到我们有许多相同的价值观有时还有相同的观点。

ex.s: "My mum was a great cook, and she'd sometimes let me have a try," he said.
ex.t: "我妈妈是一位很棒的厨师，她有时会让我试试手，"他说。

ex.s: These systems are sometimes faster and more perceptive than we humans are.
ex.t: 这些系统有时比我们人类更快、更敏锐。

ex.s: Bechtel，who works in downtown West Palm Beach，has lunch with coworkers sometimes，but like many of us，too often works through lunch at her desk.
ex.t: 贝克特尔在西棕榈滩市中心工作，有时会和同事一起吃午餐，但像我们许多人一样，她也经常在办公桌前边工作边吃午餐。

ex.s: On a regular day， students at the school sometimes come up to him to say they're not feeling well or other times to tell him about something that happened at break． He knows most of the kids at the school， but can't name each one． Some of them make him know them． Like Faith， who often forgets her backpack in the cafeteria， and Lucy， who just wants a hug．

ex.s: Everybody can buy takeaway food, but sometimes we’re not aware how cheaply we can make this food ourselves.”

ex.s: Still I unwilling to play the games for them sometimes.
